bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
stage="$root/.releases/video-sale-payment-form-417faf35"
unit=gace-userbot-verify.service
target="$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
sock="$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock"
session="$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$unit")" = active || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled "$unit")" = enabled || exit 62
test -S "$sock" && test "$(stat -c %a "$sock")" = 600 || exit 63
test ! -L "$session" && test -f "$session" && test "$(stat -c %a "$session")" = 600 || exit 64
test -s "$stage/userbot_resident_ipc.py" || exit 65
test -x "$root/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" || exit 66
before_inode="$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$session")"
python3 -B - "$stage/userbot_resident_ipc.py" <<'PY'
import ast,sys
s=open(sys.argv[1]).read();ast.parse(s)
if s.count('async def _video_sale_payment_form(')!=1 or s.count('async def _video_sale_readback(')!=1:sys.exit(67)
if not all(k in s for k in ('GetPaymentFormRequest','InputInvoiceMessage','VIDEO_SALE_LOCK_NOT_VERIFIED')):sys.exit(68)
PY
"$root/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health | grep -Fq 'USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS' || exit 69
test ! -e "$stage/backup-before-quote.py" || exit 70
cp -p "$target" "$stage/backup-before-quote.py" || exit 71
armed=NO
rollback(){ cp -p "$stage/backup-before-quote.py" "$target" || true;systemctl --user restart "$unit" || true; }
trap 'if test "$armed" = YES;then rollback;fi' EXIT
cp -p "$stage/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$target" || exit 72
armed=YES
systemctl --user restart "$unit" || exit 73
ready=NO
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8;do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$unit" 2>/dev/null)" = active && test -S "$sock";then ready=YES;break;fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = YES || exit 74
test "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$session")" = "$before_inode" && test "$(stat -c %a "$session")" = 600 || exit 75
test "$(stat -c %a "$sock")" = 600 || exit 76
"$root/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health | grep -Fq 'USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS' || exit 77
armed=NO
echo RESIDENT_USERBOT_PAYMENT_FORM_READ_ONLY_DEPLOY=PASS
echo RESIDENT_USERBOT_SESSION_PRESERVED=PASS
